description:
Scrape a website to extract contact information, social links, and content — and, when the site is an online shop, which shop system it runs and how big its catalogue is (data.shop on the results; see get_job_results for how to read it, including why null means "not measured", not "not a shop"). The results also say whether the site carries advertising tags (data.ads — its no_ad_tag_found never means "does not advertise"; see get_job_results).
This is a convenience wrapper for submit_job with type=spiderSite.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: scrape_website
